requirements.title: Flow 1: Lead Ingestion to Dual-Key Client Onboarding
Flow 2: Planning, Resource Scheduling & Materiality Formulation
Flow 3: Technical Fieldwork Execution & Multi-Tier Review Matrix
Flow 4: Reporting, 5-Part Deliverable Release & Compliance Archive
Flow 5: Practice Management, Time Realization & Firm Bookkeeping
Trial Balance Ingestion & Split Dashboard Interface
User role, security and progress rules
All 11 canonical states map to exactly one of seven phases.
Absent/one-key approvals block Engagement Letter issuance.
Both keys allow the letter but do not bypass the full 50% advance.
Changed offer or risk basis invalidates the affected approval.
Rejection/conditional clearance and open holds cannot be overwritten through tasks.
Independent reviewer and mandatory rework comments remain enforced.
Open review notes and stale materiality block subsequent professional decisions.
Critical confirmation cases block report release.
Frozen archival state requires an effective committed lock and does not imply external immutability.
Recurring templates never copy professional sign-offs as current.
Scoped actors cannot access unrelated clients.
Automation retries cannot duplicate or forge domain events.
